translations.web: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.
translations.bsb: It remained that way continually; the cloud would cover the tabernacle by day, and at night it would appear like fire.
translations.kjv: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
translations.asv: So it was alway: the cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.
